A serious traffic accident involving a dark-colored Dodge Challenger was reported along Loop 20 in Laredo early Friday morning, November 6, 2026.

Emergency personnel were arriving at the scene as the crash was reported. The circumstances surrounding the crash remain unclear, and there is currently no confirmed information regarding injuries or how many vehicles were involved.

Motorists traveling through the area are urged to exercise caution as emergency crews respond.

Source: Hammrod News Laredo TX, November 6, 2026.
